 Job Description: Senior Python Developer
 At Exiger we work every day to make the world a safer place to do business in. Our experts and technology help clients prevent breaches, respond to risk, remediate issues and monitor activities. We are searching for people who think creatively to solve complex problems related to governance, risk and compliance thus delivering first class solutions for our corporate and government partners.
 Key Responsibilities
Deliver data information and analytical work on a wide range of cases.
Deliver data, information and analytical work on a wide range of programs including proactive data creation & threat intelligence.
Provide high quality work-product while also providing insights and recommendations to other team members.
Work with Exiger’s AI powered research due diligence engine and related technologies.
Gain understanding of Exiger research methodology, tools and processes.
Understand business problem of risks and evaluate the results of your work in context of business risks.
Successfully manage project lifecycle/tasks personal workload and pipeline.
Understand the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).
 DUTIES
Loads and extracts data from Exiger Technology;
Uses technical skills e.g. SQL, Excel Formulas, Python to strengthen, speed up and scale current processes;
Provide timely and accurate reporting of activities being conducted;
Deliver data information and analytical work on a wide range of cases.
Manipulate and organize data.
Creating enterprise level applications written for scalability and reliability.
Independently query, analyze and interpret data from a wide variety of information systems
Evaluate the results of your work in a context of business risk.
 Professional Experience Required
Bachelor’s degree or Master's degree in Statistics or Applied Mathematics or equivalent experience, ideally acquired in a technical or quantitative discipline would be a plus.
6 months to 2 years’ experience using Python and SQL
Data analysis experience including use of relevant software (e.g. R, Python, VBA, etc.).
Experience using reporting and data visualization tools (e.g. Sisense, Microsoft PowerBI, Tableau, Qlikview).
Experience with data loading and data transformations primarily focused on Microsoft SQL Server - other database technologies are nice to have.
Previous experience working in RDBMS Data Structures and database concepts represents an advantage.
Experience with code repositories: check in/out/merge/branch
Experience with deployment to Kubernetes and executing in a scaled environment.
 Knowledge & Skills
Proficient written and verbal English language skills
Data analytics, pattern analysis, assessment reviews and anomaly detection skills.
Strong organizational skills, including ability to prioritize and work under pressure.
Strong interpersonal skills with effective and positive leadership qualities.
Proven quantitative, analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
The ability to independently query, analyze and interpret data from a wide variety of information systems.
A desire to understand business problems and to evaluate the results of your work in a business context.
Written and verbal communication skills that you can adapt to technical and non-technical audiences.
